fold_scoring.3d_lotto: mean unordered-multiset multinomial negative log-likelihood per digit

3d_lotto.training_target: expand each training draw into three digit observations weighted by target multiplicity
3d_lotto.probability_model: one categorical digit distribution for digits 0 through 9; unordered target likelihood includes the multinomial coefficient

3d_lotto: expanding_historical_frequency: only prior draws available before each target
lotto_6_42: uniform_random: uniformly selected set of six distinct numbers from 1 through 42
expanding_historical_frequency: precomputed prior-only expanding appearance rate
recent_30_frequency: precomputed count in the previous 30 completed draws divided by 30

rules: all remaining non-key feature columns, including prior draw summary, pattern, parity, sum, variance, and overlap context

random_baseline.3d_simulation: three iid uniform digit draws per validation row; compare unordered multiset overlap
random_baseline.642_simulation: Hypergeometric(42 population, 6 matching values, 6 selected) hits per validation row

multiple_candidate_adjustment.applies_to: two predefined all-feature Lotto 6/42 candidates in the advancement gate

bootstrap.resampling: paired row resampling for candidate and baseline differences

decision_rule.bootstrap_interval_rule: 95% paired percentile interval must exclude zero in the improving direction against fair-random and every required historical baseline
decision_rule.3d_lotto_primary_rule: lower unordered-multiset negative log-likelihood than uniform and expanding-frequency baselines
decision_rule.lotto_6_42_primary_rule: higher mean hits@6 than the fair-random expectation and both historical-frequency baselines
decision_rule.fold_rule: improve over fair-random and historical baselines in at least two of three chronological folds
decision_rule.test_gate: Phase 5A candidate-ready is not authorization to load or score the locked test partition

validation_boundary.tuning_rows: expanding-window folds within Phase 4 train partition only

3d_lotto.simulation_method: three iid uniform digits per validation row; unordered multiset overlap

lotto_6_42.simulation_method: Hypergeometric(42 population, 6 matching numbers, 6 selected) hits per validation row

mean size of intersection between predicted six-number set and actual six-number set

mean binary log loss across draws and 42 membership labels
